vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Hi, friends! Look, it's our big toy box!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Let's learn the toys, in English, and in French!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Mila hugs her doll. So soft!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: A teddy bear! He looks just like me!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Quiz time! Where is the doll?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: The little car goes vroom, vroom!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The kite flies up high in the sky!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Quiz time! Where is the kite?

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Bobo builds a tall tower with blocks!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: Boom, boom, boom! Bobo plays the drum!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Quiz time! Where is the blocks?

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: The spinning top goes round and round!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Now let's say them all in French! Listen, and say it too!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: What is YOUR favorite toy? Tell a grown-up!

vo.speaker: bobo
vo.text: My favorite is the teddy bear, of course!

vo.speaker: mila
vo.text: Time to put the toys away. Bye-bye, friends!
